scenes.basis: 10:1 "He arose from there and came into the borders of Judea and beyond the Jordan"
10:17 "As he was going out into the way" - the rich ruler scene follows 10:1 with no new place
10:32 "They were on the way, going up to Jerusalem" - not yet arrived; the road is not placed
10:46 "They came to Jericho. As he went out from Jericho... Bartimaeus... was sitting by the road"
